Quick update patch 12th Dec 2024

Last update did not include 64bit Windows build.

notes.title: Patch 6 - Alpha build 0.963
notes.notes:
Player behaviour minor change. State PlayerHitByPowerAttack locks out input for duration of state.
Game world audio playlist loop issue resolved. (Some tracks continued playing during Doom Portal Event Audio)

notes.title: Patch 5 - Alpha build 0.963
notes.notes:
Doom Portal issue with the event not firing at all. Fixed.
Incorrect UI Equipment Icons not displaying correctly upon next level load. Fixed.
Incorrect Player Equipment sprite colours applied upon next level load. Fixed.
Improved lighting in level environments.
Main Menu & Story Tell Scenes now including additional environment parts, that previously wasn't loaded/generated.

notes.title: Patch 4 - Alpha build 0.963
notes.notes:
Added SpikePit' platform to level generation.
Extended game world audio cycle to cover 2 additional tracks.
Adjustments made to basic riverside (decor) platform in level generation.
Adjustments made to pixel lighting settings, supports more lights.
Overall graphics settings adjusted to support higher textures.

notes.title: Patch 3 - Alpha build 0.963
notes.notes:
Player Evade behaviour, minor change made to distance travelled.
Replaced all previous water bodies in level generation with empty space. (Will be converted into spike pits next patch update)
Added basic riverside (decor) platform to level generation.
